related.title: LEONARDO：跨分區工作流的產物就緒契約
related.titleEn: LEONARDO: artifact readiness across heterogeneous partitions
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付層級樹、十二碎片清單、逐板失效表與限制說明；明列哪些失效域仍未覆蓋；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the hierarchy, twelve-shard manifest, per-board failure table and scope limitations. Identify which larger failure domains and reconstruction requirements remain outside the demonstrated acceptance claim. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 產物清單包含大小、雜湊、格式版本、單位與 ready 狀態；求解器僅能讀取完整驗證且版本相容的產物。
related.differenceEn: Define a manifest with size, hash, format version, physical units and ready status. The solver may consume only an artifact whose validation has completed and whose format contract matches the requested executable.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 最壞單板損失比例為該板碎片數最大值除以全部碎片數；此比例描述暴露面，不代表系統失效機率；十二個等大且互異的碎片，名義每板四片分三板；變更每板兩片分六板；名義式 4/12*100 = 33.3333333333 %；變更式 2/12*100 = 16.6666666667 %。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
此串行模型的關鍵路徑為前處理時間加傳輸時間加求解時間；資料驗證已包含在前處理，不能再假設未宣告的重疊；前處理 120 秒、求解 60 秒、產物 40 GB；有效傳輸率由 2 改為 1 GB/s；名義式 120+40/2+60 = 200 s；變更式 120+40/1+60 = 220 s。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Worst single-board exposure is the largest shard count in one board divided by the total number of shards. It measures placement exposure, not failure probability or recoverability without a separate redundancy contract. Place twelve equal-sized, distinct shards across three teaching boards with four shards per board, then across six boards with two each. This deliberately reduced hierarchy is separate from Fugaku’s published hardware counts. Nominal 4/12*100 = 33.3333333333 %; changed 2/12*100 = 16.6666666667 %. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

In this serial model, the critical path adds preprocessing, transfer and solve times. Validation is included in preprocessing, and undeclared overlap is not permitted when computing the promised completion time. Preprocessing takes 120 seconds, solving takes 60 seconds and the artifact is 40 decimal GB. Effective transfer rate changes from 2 to 1 GB/s; these are synthetic end-to-end rates, not interconnect specifications. Nominal 120+40/2+60 = 200 s; changed 120+40/1+60 = 220 s. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: PCIe AER：祖先轉報與根因識別的分離
related.titleEn: PCIe AER: separating propagated reports from root-cause evidence
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付層級樹、十二碎片清單、逐板失效表與限制說明；明列哪些失效域仍未覆蓋；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the hierarchy, twelve-shard manifest, per-board failure table and scope limitations. Identify which larger failure domains and reconstruction requirements remain outside the demonstrated acceptance claim. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 產生 requester 到上游 reporter 的拓撲關聯與逐事件分組；保留原始報告，不能只留下已去重總數。
related.differenceEn: Build requester-to-upstream-reporter relationships and group rows by incident identity. Preserve original reports alongside the normalized view so correlation decisions can be reviewed rather than hidden inside one aggregate.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 最壞單板損失比例為該板碎片數最大值除以全部碎片數；此比例描述暴露面，不代表系統失效機率；十二個等大且互異的碎片，名義每板四片分三板；變更每板兩片分六板；名義式 4/12*100 = 33.3333333333 %；變更式 2/12*100 = 16.6666666667 %。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

教學紀錄中每個 incident_id 恰有三筆不同層級報告；唯一事故數等於報告數除以三，但實作須依鍵去重而非盲目除法；名義十二筆報告對應四個事件；變更十五筆對應五個；每筆帶 requester、reporter、severity 與 incident_id；名義式 12/3 = 4 incidents；變更式 15/3 = 5 incidents。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Worst single-board exposure is the largest shard count in one board divided by the total number of shards. It measures placement exposure, not failure probability or recoverability without a separate redundancy contract. Place twelve equal-sized, distinct shards across three teaching boards with four shards per board, then across six boards with two each. This deliberately reduced hierarchy is separate from Fugaku’s published hardware counts. Nominal 4/12*100 = 33.3333333333 %; changed 2/12*100 = 16.6666666667 %. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

Each synthetic incident has exactly three reports at different levels. The arithmetic count is reports divided by three, while a robust implementation must deduplicate incident keys instead of assuming this multiplicity in real logs. Twelve nominal reports represent four incidents; fifteen changed reports represent five. Each row includes requester, reporter, severity and incident_id, with invented stable correlation identifiers. Nominal 12/3 = 4 incidents; changed 15/3 = 5 incidents. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
